svg.title: Experience
svg.desc: Security Engineer at Aexantis Technologies (Jan 2026 to present); Senior Executive Cybersecurity at Anmol Industries (Jul to Nov 2025); IT Specialist SOC Support at SBI General Insurance (Dec 2024 to Jul 2025); Cybersecurity Trainer for IBM ICT Initiative via Secuneus Tech; Cybersecurity Analyst Intern at TCS (Dec 2023 to Jun 2024).

g.text: Aexantis Technologies Pvt. Ltd. · Ghaziabad, UP
› Web, API and network pentests for enterprise and government clients, scoping to reporting
› Built the GRC practice (ISO 27001, SOC 2, PCI DSS, HIPAA, GDPR) · CERT-In + GeM strategy · 97% retention
› Full-scope VAPT across web, APIs, industrial OT networks and internal infrastructure
› 20+ critical vulns found (auth bypass, privesc) · CVSS-scored reports with PoC + exec roadmaps
› Phishing + spoofing simulations cut real phishing incidents by 60%
› SPF / DKIM / DMARC implemented and validated · 100+ incidents triaged across BFSI infrastructure
IBM ICT Initiative · via Secuneus Tech
› Offensive security training on Nmap, Wireshark, Kali Linux and Metasploit to 600+ students
› Analysed 5,000+ daily network events in Splunk and QRadar: intrusions, brute force, lateral movement
› Nessus + OpenVAS scans surfaced 20+ high-risk issues and supported remediation
